We are Bertrandt
 An independent, international engineering service provider with decades of expertise. With cross-industry know-how and a comprehensive understanding of systems and products, we create technological solutions across the entire value chain. We focus on the trending topics of digitalization, e-mobility, and autonomous systems, primarily for the automotive, aerospace, defense, and mechanical engineering industries, consistently enabling the development of tailor-made solutions. Our goal: to accelerate technological progress and make a meaningful contribution to a sustainable future. We work toward this every day - with approximately 12,000 employees at over 50 locations worldwide.
 What To Expect
Design and integration of medium to high complexity hardware systems and schematics, including performing design reviews of automotive electronic components and ECUs in accordance with internal guidelines and customer-specific processes;
Perform hardware verification measurements using oscilloscopes in accordance with design and schematic specifications, covering interfaces such as USB, CAN, PCI/PCIe, video, Ethernet, and high-speed memories;
Develop, test, and verify analog and digital functional blocks (e.g., power supplies, audio blocks, MCU/SoC units) within complex hardware architectures;
Support the design, development, and implementation of both hardware and software for infotainment systems;
Prepare measurement reports and maintain technical documentation;
Communicate critical issues promptly to the customer and responsible departments; escalate according to project rules.
 What You Bring Along
Bachelor or Master in Electrical Engineering, Electronics or related field.
Experience: Minimum 5 years of proven experience in hardware development, with a strong background in the automotive industry.
Knowledge of common infotainment system interfaces (PCIe, UART, TDM, video, I2C, I2S, USB).
Solid understanding of analog and digital circuit design principles and component selection.
Experience with high-frequency (HF) measurements
Strong understanding of Power Integrity, ensuring stable power delivery for reliable system performance.
Experience with schematic and PCB layout analysis.
Good communication skills in English.
 What We Offer
Flexible work environment
Private health insurance with optional medical packages for you and your family.
24 vacation days, increasing to 25 days after 3+ years with us.
Meal tickets and Holiday vouchers.
Bookster and 7Card subscription.
 At Bertrandt, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on the experience and skills of the applicants. People with severe disabilities or those deemed equivalent under SGB IX are warmly welcomed and will be given preference in hiring if equally qualified.
